_comment: Copy this file OUTSIDE the repo, fill it in, and put it on the SD card as /.keepsake/provision.json. Keepsake imports it on the next start, then wipes and deletes it. Every setting is optional; delete the lines you don't need. Dates are "MM-DD" or "YYYY-MM-DD" (with the year, anniversaries count: "Happy 5th anniversary!"). Never commit the filled-in copy.
welcome_message: Happy birthday! I made you a little reading companion.
